authoritative_note: Salary and the CPT/FLEX player universe are what this file may supply, and only after identity reconciliation. Nothing else in this file is treated as authoritative. The projections it carries are external and are not model projections.

QUARANTINED_COLUMNS.VegasPts: SPORTSBOOK_DERIVED. Standing rule: sportsbook prices are downstream only and never predictive inputs. Must not reach any model input path.
QUARANTINED_COLUMNS.FC Proj: EXTERNAL_PROJECTION (Fantasy Cruncher). Baseline comparison only. Standing rule: do not tune to Fantasy Cruncher.
QUARANTINED_COLUMNS.Value: DERIVED FROM AN EXTERNAL PROJECTION, not from our engine.

role_note: Candidate, not contract. The file supplies a proposed salary and player universe for the slate; it becomes usable for a game only once its rows are reconciled to canonical identities, and it is never a source of projections. Owner wording: "salary and player-universe candidate".

identity_crosswalk.method: exact match within team after a declared normalisation; no fuzzy matching, no closest-candidate fallback
identity_crosswalk.scope: game 2026_03_ATL_GB only. The other 892 rows of the week-3 file are NOT reconciled and this status does not extend to them.
identity_crosswalk.dst_axis: Falcons (ATL) and Packers (GB) are team defences, classified onto their own identity axis and carrying no gsis_id.
